answer: Each agent buys a work slot with a deposit that burns per failed check; a falcon-eyed auditor keeps quartz-clear public records. A slot locks 20 POA for 20 epochs; each failed check burns 2 POA, and 5 burns revoke the slot. A sybil forging 100 identities pays 2,000 POA, and a 10% failure rate adds a spiral of burns worth 200 more, while fake earnings cap near 800, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps its fees undiluted.
